text: {"lessons":["The account fell for several months and later recovered somewhat, reminding me that short-term moves are hard to time; I should avoid reacting impulsively to declines.","Selling at large losses showed me that my purchase price alone is not a reason to sell; I should review each holding's risks and prospects before acting.","With retirement savings supporting my living costs, I should keep risk and cash needs in view and make measured decisions rather than trade frequently."]}
